items.title: Cyber investigating suspected $1 million bridge exploit as Upbit, Bithumb freeze transfers
items.teaser: South Korean exchanges Upbit and Bithumb both suspended CYBER deposits and withdrawals, citing a suspected security incident.

items.title: Cross-chain protocol Chainflip's FLIP tanks 30% after suspected $4.86 million vault drain
items.teaser: The withdrawal carried a valid signature, which Onchain Lens said points to a possible compromise of the key validators use to approve vault payouts.

items.title: XRP falls 10% as long bets unwind and ETF assets slip below $1 billion
items.teaser: The token broke its previous November lows during Saturday's crypto selloff, with long positions accounting for most XRP liquidations and technical indicators showing further weakness.
